_apiko_notes: Stack-agnostic base. context7 = version-correct library docs for any ecosystem (kills invented APIs). serena = language-server-backed code navigation, so the agent stops grep-crawling a large repo.

No backend-specific MCP server is wired yet. A Prisma-aware server is available as a plugin (claude plugin install prisma@claude-plugins-official) if the team wants it - not installed by default; add it and record it in docs/AGENT_TOOLING.md if you do.
GitHub (PRs, issues, CI) is recommended and installs as a plugin: claude plugin install github@claude-plugins-official

Policy: <=5 active servers per session; a CLI beats an MCP server when it does the same job; secrets only via ${ENV_VAR}; every server that reaches a client system needs a row in docs/AGENT_TOOLING.md and client approval.
